summary: The guest walks out of the kitchen through the swing door, which swings shut behind him, leaving the host alone with the burning oven.
framing: Close shot at head height on the kitchen side of the swing door, looking at the guest's back; static camera. Door frame fills the middle of frame, blue wall strip at far left, blue and green vertical wall bands at right.

cast.visible: back of head and shoulders, from behind

props: purple kitchen swing door, hinged on its right edge (screen), swinging closed behind the guest and then past closed

beats.action: back to camera at left of frame, walking away through the doorway toward screen-left; head turned to left profile, eye half-lidded looking down-left, mouth closed
swing door stands open, seen as a narrow panel right of the guest; it swings closed toward camera-left through the shot, widening every 2 frames
steps forward and left, body lunges larger in frame, head turns further away so only the cheek and one eye show
half out of frame at the left edge, only back of head and right shoulder visible
only a sliver of head, collar and shoulder at the left edge
only the shoulder at the bottom-left corner; door now covers most of the doorway
door flat-on and fully closed, filling the doorway; push plate visible low on its left edge
door overswings past closed, away from camera: panel narrows from the left and a strip of blue wall opens at its left edge

notes: Animated on twos: new drawings on 1587, 1589, 1591 ... 1603. Camera static, agrees with timeline.json; the large image change is the door panel sweeping across frame, not a camera move. The door is still swinging on the last frame (1603).
